title: This is so comfortable
text: This is so comfortable. I prefer a soft bed and this makes it so comfortable.  I do find I'm a little warm with it but it could just be hot flashes.  It stays in place without sliding around on the mattress.  It had a slight smell when first opened, but that didn't stay long and it didn't take long to fluff up.

product_metadata.title: Sealy Mattress Topper, Queen, Blue
features: SEALY MATTRESS TOPPER—The same quality you trust from Sealy mattresses, now in a 3-inch memory foam mattress topper that responds to your shape
GEL INFUSED FOAM—This memory foam topper is infused with gel for conforming medium-firm support, added flexibility, and to promote less heat retention while you sleep
MULTI-USE TOPPER—Whether you’re refreshing your bed or upgrading a guest room, get a better night’s sleep anywhere with this versatile mattress pad
BUILT TO LAST—Since 1881, we’ve been committed to making sleep products of enduring quality, so you can sleep better tonight, and tomorrow, and every night after
description: Give new life to old or uncomfortable mattresses—or treat yourself to an extra boost of comfort—with this Sealy mattress topper. Our conforming memory foam is infused with gel for added flexibility and to help you retain less heat while you sleep. This queen gel mattress topper adds 3 inches of conforming support to any mattress, anywhere: in dorm rooms, campers, guest rooms, and more. So no matter where you are, you can sleep soundly on the Sealy quality you trust. This mattress topper foam is CertiPUR-US certified meaning it is made without ozone-depleting chemicals.
